name: isEDREnabled
definition: True when at least one non-mobile CrowdStrike Falcon host runs a sensor outside Reduced Functionality Mode, with an agent_version and a sensor_update policy. ANY ONE such sensor makes it true: it says EDR telemetry is switched on somewhere in the tenant, not that it covers the fleet (coverage is requiredCoveragePercentage).
population: non-mobile hosts returned by the Falcon host-details read
evidenceRequiredForTrue: at least one host record with reduced_functionality_mode not true, a non-empty agent_version and a sensor_update policy
citations: safeguards/epp/crowdstrike-falcon/isEDREnabled.py: the enabled_count > 0 rule and the create_response result

changeLog.change: Registered at V0 so the registry gate can fail push runs on main; proposed, single emitter. The any-one-sensor rule is recorded as written, not endorsed.
